Almighty
Dazzling Gleam
moves.description:
Activation Condition:
When the user’s [Name:ReferencedMessageTag ] is raised.
Deactivation Condition:
Cannot be deactivated.

Lowers the target’s [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="2" ] by [Digit:1digit Idx="3" ] stat [EN:Qty Ref="3" S="rank" P="ranks" ]. The power of this move is not lowered even if there are multiple targets. If the user’s Gardevoir has Mega Evolved, also decreases the amount of move gauge slots needed to use this move by [Digit:1digit Idx="1" ].

moves.name:
Almighty
Moonblast
moves.description:
Activation Condition:
When the user’s Gardevoir Mega Evolves.
Deactivation Condition:
Cannot be deactivated.

Never misses. The more the user’s [Name:ReferencedMessageTag ] is increased, the greater the power of this attack. Has a chance ([Digit:2digits Idx="1" ]%) of lowering the target’s [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="2" ] by [Digit:1digit Idx="3" ] stat [EN:Qty Ref="3" S="rank" P="ranks" ]. The power and chance of applying additional effects of this move are not lowered even if there are multiple targets. Removes all of the user’s [Name:ReferencedMessageTag ] ranks.
